title: Spyglass: Unlocking Powerful New Insights
summary: We are excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, empowering you with a robust new tool to gain deeper understanding and make more informed decisions.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your images and documents and customize their appearance directly within the editor for a more powerful and personalized experience.

title: Introducing the Noeko Product Roadmap
summary: We're excited to launch our new product roadmap, providing a clear view of what we've shipped, what's coming next, and what's on the horizon.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes for Seamless Task Management
summary: Enjoy more intuitive and visually appealing checkboxes that are easier to click and drag, making your task management smoother than ever.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've upgraded your collaborative editing experience, making it easier and more intuitive to work with your team in real-time.

title: Enhanced Shared Content Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and utilize all your shared content with improved search and visibility features, fostering richer collaboration.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We're thrilled to introduce comprehensive international language support, making Noeko accessible and enjoyable for users worldwide in their native tongue.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: We're making Noeko open source to empower our community with greater control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's evolution.

title: Intelligent Constellation View
summary: Unleash the full potential of your knowledge base with the new Intelligent Constellation View, offering powerful filtering by tags, time, and shared content to streamline your workflows.

title: Unlock Your Knowledge: Powerful Search and Custom Collections
summary: Effortlessly discover and organize your information with powerful new search filters and the ability to save custom collections for quick access.

title: Enhanced Content Previews and Organization
summary: Experience a more intuitive way to structure your thoughts with flexible new options for displaying and interacting with linked content directly within your notes.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosting & Flexible Plans
summary: Get ready to experience Noeko with newfound freedom, offering versatile self-hosting options and flexible paid plans to perfectly fit your needs.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Enhanced Visuals
summary: Get ready for a fresh new look as we enhance our existing themes and introduce a vibrant collection of new styles for a personalized experience.

title: Personalized Welcome Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your homepage greeting always accurately reflects the time of day, making your experience more welcoming and precise.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Seamlessly unapply tags, delete entries, and view details for multiple items directly from the tag view, giving you powerful, centralized control over your content.

title: Unlock More Content Formats
summary: Seamlessly integrate a wider variety of content, including videos, websites, and text, to centralize all your information and enhance your research experience.
